.. change::
    :tags: usecase, postgresql, reflection
    :tickets: 13577

    The PostgreSQL dialect now reflects an index that the database marks as
    invalid, which is what a failed ``CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY`` leaves
    behind, with ``postgresql_invalid`` set to ``True`` in the index's
    ``dialect_options``.  Healthy indexes are reflected unchanged.  The
    ``postgresql_invalid`` parameter is accepted by :class:`.Index` so that a
    reflected :class:`.Table` can still be re-created; it has no effect on the
    emitted DDL.
